background: Northern Trust Corporation is the holding company of a Chicago-based custodian and wealth manager, earning fees from asset servicing for institutions and from managing money for wealthy families and foundations.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest at A, all on a stable outlook. Leverage of 8.5% is in the top quarter of US banks, but CET1 of 12.0% is below the peer median and LCR of 107% is in the bottom quarter, the weak spot. Since 31 Mar 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.9 points, leverage 0.6 points and Tier 1 leverage 0.7 points, so the trend in capital is gently down. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
